decision: Replace the PeeringDB facility 16131 point with the planar centroid of the Dallas Central Appraisal District real-property parcel at 1001 E Campbell Rd, the address 365 Data Centers publishes for TX1; DCAD lists a business-personal-property account for 365 OPERATING COMPANY at the same address.
computation: The parcel ring (returned in EPSG:4326 by the service with outSR=4326) was projected to NAD83 / Texas North Central (ftUS) (EPSG:2276) with pyproj 3.7.1, its planar centroid computed with shapely 2.1.1 and transformed back to WGS84: [-96.70749405064191, 32.97614795083433], rounded to 7 decimals.

census_geocoder_point.note: Interpolated on the Campbell Rd centreline side (TIGER line 103258723, range 901-1001); not used as the locator because it falls on the street frontage outside the parcel.

identity_bridge: 365 Data Centers' Richardson page gives 1001 E Campbell Road, Richardson, TX 75081; DCAD's parcel publishing layer returns one real-property parcel at 1001 E CAMPBELL RD and, under the same parent parcel, a business-personal-property account for 365 OPERATING COMPANY.
nearby_records_within_2km: Only this site (curated:365-richardson-campus, 16 m from the new point) in the current dataset; no pending queue addition, locator correction or claim within 2 km. The hundredtwentieth holds file keeps a lead_only entry for 2801 Telecom Pkwy, Richardson (no coordinates), which names TX1 as the nearest Atlas record.
